newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Chu Kong Shipping surges on heavy buying.
newsitem.headline: Chu Kong Shipping surges on heavy buying.

text.p: Shares of Chu Kong Shipping Development Co Ltd rose steeply on Monday morning on heavy volume, benefitting from market fever over red chips, brokers said.
The shares rose HK$1.00 to HK$4.60 before easing to HK$4.55 on volume of 114.26 million shares worth HK$470.38 million.
Chu Kong Shipping was boosted by hopes of future asset injections and the market enthusiasm red chips have generated, said Alex Tang, head of research at Yamaichi International.
Red chips are China-backed Hong Kong-incorporated firms.
Chu Kong Shipping shares made their debut on Friday with a 200 percent gain over the public offering price of HK$1.20.
